messages:
Marta: Quick async check — quarterly OKR milestone for routing & canary rollout. Please post: what shipped, what slipped, current blockers, owners, and next steps. I want a short bulleted update from each owner by EOD so I can escalate if needed. :spiral_calendar:

Sam: Shipped: routing-v1 canary -> 20% yesterday. Slipped: adaptive-batching improvements (moved to next sprint). Owner: Sam. Next: need CR review + canary to 50%. CR #482 is the blocker.

Deepa: Shipped: quant profiling for 3 priority models; integrated traces into the eval harness. Blocker: perf regression on long sequences after the quant patch (p99 latency up). Owner: Deepa. Need kernel-level traces + Jordan to pair.

Jordan: I can pair tonight. Reproducer I used:
```
python tools/repro_long_seq.py --model gpt-small --seq 4096 --batch 1
```
Post traces to /shared/traces and ping me.

Priya: Dependency note — Dedicated infra needs the dataset migration for routing rules (blocked by infra DB maintenance). ETA Tue morning (2026-03-17). Owner: Priya. This blocks dedicated rollforward beyond 10%.

Liam: Observability — Canary at 20% saw 95th latency 85ms -> 130ms on p99 for a subset of requests. I've throttled traffic to 10% to reduce impact and opened an incident in #eng-sre. If we push to 50% we'll need rollback conditions in the runbook.

Sam: Thanks @Liam. I'll open a short rollback runbook and ping infra. Reassigning CR #482 to @Deepa for quick perf-aware review?

Deepa: Yep, I'll take CR review and focus on the quant diff. Will run kernel traces tonight and post a summary.

deploy-bot: deploy routing-v1-canary started at 2026-03-16T22:10Z — status: partial success (7/10 hosts healthy, 3 hosts failed to start the runtime).

Marta: Action items I captured: 1) Sam -> finish CR #482, add rollback PR if needed. 2) Deepa + Jordan -> reproduce + kernel traces, post results. 3) Priya -> unblock DB migration or provide temporary rule sync. 4) Liam -> monitor canary SLOs and confirm rollback thresholds. I'll summarize and escalate to Eng leadership by 5pm PT. :white_check_mark:

Sam: I'll add notes to the PR and link the rollback runbook: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/482 (will mark as urgent).

Deepa: Running reproducer now, will upload perf traces to /shared/traces/trace-routing-20260316 and tag @Jordan.

Marta: Thanks all — please keep updates short in this thread only (so I can copy out). If anything critical pops, ping me DM and @eng-oncall.

Sam: Will do.

Liam: Monitoring — posting a quick dashboard snapshot in #eng-sre, will update every 30m until stable.
